inference.independent_unit: initial_id; the 9 factor cells and 13 methods are repeated paired measures
inference.aggregation: first average paired contrasts within initial, then equal-weight the three regimes
inference.intervals: stratified paired cluster bootstrap resampling initials within regime
inference.primary_tests: One-sided centered cluster-bootstrap margin tests at failure difference 0.01 and failure-penalized cost gain 0, with Holm familywise adjustment across three models.
inference.displayed_intervals: Unadjusted one-sided percentile intervals, descriptive only
inference.degenerate_rule: Zero within-stratum/stratified-bootstrap variance, zero cluster variance, or no nonzero failure contrast is untestable and fails closed; zero observed discordance is not a rare-event population certificate.
inference.multiplicity: Holm familywise alpha 0.05 across the three fixed models, separately per primary estimand
inference.no_pseudoreplication: 22,464 SUMO runs are not treated as independent samples

primary.margin_test_note: Holm-adjusted one-sided centered cluster-bootstrap margin tests are the frozen decisions. Displayed percentile bounds are explicitly unadjusted and descriptive. Degenerate cluster contrasts are untestable and fail closed; no finite-sample population-risk guarantee is made.

scope.applies_to: Three longitudinal actors on the existing fixed-route SUMO merge, the three frozen learned model sets, the unchanged V35 rules and exactly the declared generators.
does_not_establish: lane-changing, vision, arbitrary traffic density or real-vehicle validity
formal safety under compound mismatch or perception error
population risk certification or superiority outside the frozen mixture
a new MARL training algorithm or equilibrium guarantee
